_comment: Default content-type -> generation-engine routing. Shared across all clients unless a client's config.json sets routing_overrides for a given content_type. Extend this file (add new content_type keys) as new engines/techniques come online instead of hardcoding routing logic in scripts.
_execution_note: As of 2026-08-23: Higgsfield dropped (cost). fal.ai MCP confirmed CONNECTED and WORKING on the user's LOCAL Claude Code CLI (C:\Users\dreid) — verified end-to-end with a real 3s text-to-video generation (alibaba/happy-horse/text-to-video, $0.14/sec, ~$0.42 for 3s, 1920x1080 output — note: default aspect ratio was 16:9, must be explicitly requested as 9:16/vertical for ISO Order's social formats). fal.ai's domain is still egress-blocked from remote/cloud sessions, so generation must continue to run from that local session — the user runs the prompt there and hands the output file to the remote session for post-production + publishing.
